request.subject: CURIOSITY:WEB

layers.text: Add only two tiny details: one small bone-white skull with a thin black outline caught on the web near its upper left rim, and one small bone with a thin black outline near its lower right rim. Do not redraw anything else: keep every bone-white thread of the web exactly the same; transparent background between the threads.
